fixer.title: agentHost: offer Context Size for extension BYOK models in Copilot sessions

cases.mechanism: Registering only the model's maximum prompt budget delayed compaction until the full advertised window, causing every later turn in long sessions to repeatedly serialize, transmit, and process a much larger prompt history than a user-selected smaller budget requires.
cases.symptom: Long BYOK sessions on very large-context models incur increasing per-turn request bytes, token processing, and latency until the full advertised prompt limit is reached.
cases.fixedBehavior: The session launcher now resolves an offered BYOK context size per session and registers the model with that bounded prompt/window limit; live changes re-register through the existing serialized provider.sync path before setModel, and resume uses the stored selection.
cases.evidence: Before this PR, synthesizeByokSessionConfig copied each BYOK model's advertised maxPromptTokens directly into ProviderModelConfig (base line 661), so the runtime's compaction budget could not reflect a smaller model selection. The added getByokSessionModelLimits path resolves the selected/default context size and lowers both maxPromptTokens and maxContextWindowTokens; the added bundled-runtime integration test demonstrates that these ProviderModelConfig limits become session.usage_info.tokenLimit and assistant.usage.maxPromptTokens at launch, after provider.sync, and on resume. Thus a long BYOK conversation that previously remained eligible to grow to the advertised 968K prompt budget can now compact at the selected 200K budget before subsequent turns.
